Name: Cooler Void Pendant
Author: TheAppleSauceIsStale
Description:
I've been a little disappointed with how the void pendant looks in vanilla, so I've redesigned it a little with things significant to shadow people in mind (or at least some of Krobus's gift tastes.)

This mod replaces the void pendant with a sprite I think is in the proximity of "cooler than what we got." 

There's two configurable options: A dark and spooky bat brooch, and a little golden pumpkin that's appeared to have... sprouted? Both attached to that trademark thin red string to wear around your neck.

A little heavy, but it's the thought that counts!

Other mods seen in images: 

- Yellog's Furniture
- Rustic Country Walls and Floors
